key_insight: IteraSim RAG improves OpenFOAM case generation by separating query expansion, retrieval routing, and agent roles so CFD inputs can be assembled more reliably than with a single flat LLM-RAG workflow.
engineering_relevance: This matters for CFD practitioners because it lowers the barrier to creating consistent OpenFOAM dictionaries for solver setup, turbulence models, boundary conditions, and troubleshooting.
method: LLM expands each request into physics, solver-keyword, and troubleshooting queries.
Reciprocal Rank Fusion merges retrieved results, then MMR re-ranks candidates from an HNSW dense vector store.
A keyword router and three agents (Architect, InputWriter, Reviewer) split workflow, drafting, and verification tasks.
evidence_signal: On a released 28-case benchmark, the system achieved 77.9% mean retrieval coverage, with the parameter-modification cases exceeding 90%, and all six reference configurations completed successfully in OpenFOAM v2506.
watch_item: Performance depends on a canonical knowledge layer and a bounded Reviewer loop, so robustness to novel physics or cases outside the benchmark may still be limited.
paper_title: IteraSim RAG: A Multi-Stage Retrieval-Augmented Agentic Back-End for OpenFOAM-Based Computational Fluid Dynamics
